attacks.claim: Law 15-01 (maintenance fund), which k22 and k31 describe as the governing text, was repealed by Law 24-01 of 11 February 2024 on special measures for obtaining maintenance. The new law also covers the divorced woman's own maintenance and the children's provisional maintenance ordered while a divorce action is pending, not only the divorced woman's children. A request to the fund goes to the president of the family section with a bailiff's report of non-execution. Under article 6, the judge passes the request to the public prosecutor so that criminal proceedings for non-payment are opened on the prosecutor's own initiative.

source.what: Law 24-01 of 11 February 2024, JO 10/2024 (11 February 2024): art. 1 and 2 at page 4, art. 3 to 6 at page 5, art. 22 (repeal of Law 15-01) at page 6. The French edition is https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/jo-francais/2024/F2024010.pdf, pages 4 to 6.

attacks.quoteArabic: المادة 22 : تلغى أحكام القانون رقم 15-01 المؤرخ في 13 ربيع الأول عام 1436 الموافق 4 يناير سنة 2015 والمتضمن إنشاء صندوق النفقة، وكذا كل الأحكام المخالفة لهذا القانون. — المادة 2 : النفقة : المبلغ المالي المحكوم به قضاءً وفقا لأحكام قانون الأسرة لصالح الطفل أو الأطفال المحضونين بعد طلاق الوالدين وكذا النفقة المحكوم بها مؤقتا لصالح الطفل أو الأطفال في حالة رفع دعوى الطلاق. وتشمل أيضا النفقة المحكوم بها للمرأة المطلقة. — المادة 6 : ... يُخطر القاضي المختص وكيل الجمهورية بالطلب، قصد تحريك الدعوى العمومية تلقائيا ضد المدين من أجل جنحة عدم دفع النفقة.
attacks.consequence: k22, k31 and open point o5 should name Law 24-01 (JO 10/2024) as the text in force and record that Law 15-01 is repealed. The fund boundary should cover the divorced wife's maintenance and provisional child maintenance, not only children after divorce. Article 7 requires the order to state the amount for each creditor (مبلغ النفقة بالنسبة لكل دائن بالنفقة). The petition should therefore keep separate amounts for the wife and for each child, as request r1 already does. Request r3 (idda maintenance) should also be stated separately. Boundary k21 should note that a fund request itself starts the criminal prosecution.

attacks.claim: Idda maintenance (article 61, request r3) exists only during the waiting period of a divorce. Under article 58, the waiting period binds only a divorced woman whose marriage was consummated, or a pregnant woman under article 60. The record merges consummation and the mere call to it in one slot, consummation_or_invitation. So a wife who was called to consummation but never consummated gets r3 proposed with no warning: n6 stays silent because the slot is 'yes', and n5 only asks the lawyer to check the period. Article 58 also fixes the length of the period (three menstrual cycles, or three months from the declaration of divorce), which k46 says no cited text states.

source.what: Law 84-11 (Family Code), JO 24/1984 of 12 June 1984, page 615, arts. 58, 60 and 61 (French edition read on the page). The Arabic words are from the store text view (family-code 58 ¶1 and 61 ¶1, law-84-11 wording, which Ordinance 05-02 left unchanged: its touched list, read in JO 15/2005, does not include arts. 58 to 61).

attacks.quoteArabic: تعتد المطلقة المدخول بها غير الحامل بثلاثة قروء، واليائس من المحيض بثلاثة أشهر من تاريخ التصريح بالطلاق. — ولها الحق في النفقة في عدة الطلاق.
attacks.consequence: Request r3 should depend on actual consummation (or pregnancy), not on the merged consummation_or_invitation slot. At least, the record should warn when the divorced wife was only called to consummation. Boundary n5 and k46 can cite art. 58 and art. 60 for the length of the period and its start (التصريح بالطلاق). Then a claim for the former wife's own maintenance beyond about three months after the divorce is flagged on the text, not left to the lawyer.

attacks.target: n3, n9, n10, k11, maintenance_for, e4
attacks.claim: Common case: after a divorce, the custodial mother claims maintenance 'for the children', and one of them is over the age of majority but still studying. Under article 75 the father still owes maintenance for that child, so this is not the article 77 kinship maintenance where n3 sends an 'adult child'. But the mother's capacity rests on guardianship. Article 87 gives the father guardianship of minor children only, and paragraph 3 gives the custodian that guardianship on divorce. The adult child must therefore sue in his own name, and lack of standing is raised by the court of its own motion. The record misroutes this case or stays silent: n9 fires only during the marriage, n10 has no condition, and the maintenance_for choices force 'children' (no warning) or 'ascendant_or_descendant' (the wrong basis).

source.what: Ordinance 05-02 of 27 February 2005, JO 15/2005, page 20, art. 17 rewriting Family Code art. 87. With it: CPCA (Law 08-09) art. 13, JO 21/2008 page 4 (https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/jo-francais/2008/F2008021.pdf), and Family Code art. 75 (JO 24/1984). The Arabic words are from the store text views. Lead, tier 3: Supreme Court 19/04/1994, file 103637, as reported on mohamah.net (https://www.mohamah.net/law/?p=78268): maintenance continues after majority for a child still studying.

attacks.quoteArabic: يكون الأب وليا على أولاده القصر ... وفي حالة الطلاق، يمنح القاضي الولاية لمن أسندت له حضانة الأولاد. — يثير القاضي تلقائيا انعدام الصفة في المدعي أو في المدعى عليه. — وتستمر في حالة ما إذا كان الولد عاجزا لآفة عقلية أو بدنية أو مزاولا للدراسة
attacks.consequence: The record should ask whether any child for whom maintenance is claimed has reached majority. If so, it should warn, under art. 87 and CPCA 13 ¶2, that this child must be the plaintiff in his own name, while the claim still rests on art. 75 (studies or disability) and not on art. 77. Boundary n3 and the 'adult child' wording of the ascendant_or_descendant choice should not send a studying adult child to art. 77.

attacks.claim: The record has no fact or rule for a divorce action already pending between the same spouses. In that action the divorce judge can order every provisional measure, by an order that cannot be appealed (CPCA 442; Family Code 57 bis). The final divorce judgment decides maintenance as one of its financial aspects. A separate maintenance action filed meanwhile is connected to the divorce case, and the court seised second can hand it over on request or of its own motion (CPCA 55 and 56). For a lawyer the right route is a request inside the pending divorce case, not a stand-alone petition. The record would draft a stand-alone petition with no warning.

source.what: Law 08-09 (CPCA), JO 21/2008 of 23 April 2008: arts. 53 to 56 at page 8 and art. 442 at page 32 (French edition read on the page; not touched by Law 22-13 according to the ledger). The Arabic words are from the store text view (cpca 442 ¶1, 55 ¶1, 56 ¶1). See also Law 24-01 art. 2 (JO 10/2024 p. 4) on provisional child maintenance «في حالة رفع دعوى الطلاق».

attacks.quoteArabic: يمكن للقاضي منح الزوجين مهلة تفكير لإجراء محاولة صلح جديدة، كما يجوز له اتخاذ ما يراه لازما من التدابير المؤقتة بموجب أمر غير قابل لأي طعن. — تقوم حالة الارتباط عند وجود علاقة بين قضايا مرفوعة أمام تشكيلات مختلفة لنفس الجهة القضائية، أو أمام جهات قضائية مختلفة، والتي تستلزم لحسن سير العدالة أن ينظر ويفصل فيها معا. — التخلي عن النزاع بسبب الارتباط ... بناء على طلب أحد الخصوم أو تلقائيا.
attacks.consequence: The record should add a question on whether a divorce, judicial-divorce or khul action is pending between the parties. If one is, it should warn that maintenance and housing should be asked as provisional measures or accessory requests in that case (CPCA 442, FC 57 bis, FC 57), and that a separate petition may be joined to it or handed over to it (CPCA 55-56).

attacks.claim: The Supreme Court is reported to hold that the husband's duty of maintenance falls for the wife's breach (nushuz), but that the breach is proved only by a bailiff's report drawn up when executing a court judgment, typically a judgment ordering her return to the marital home. The record says no text makes the breach a bar (k9 'doesNotApply', o4 grade D) and has no fact for the common case: a wife living at her family's home after the husband obtained a return judgment (CPCA 423 item 1, 426 item 3) that she refused to carry out.

source.what: Commentary site (mohamah.net), not the court's own publication. It cites a Supreme Court decision of 12/01/2012, file number reported as «00054-12» (the format looks garbled), and decision 22/02/2002, file 237148 (the wife's own means do not end maintenance). Neither was found on coursupreme.dz in this search.

attacks.quoteArabic: إلا في حالة النشوز الذي لا يثبت إلا بتحرير محضر تنفيذا لحكم قضائي
attacks.consequence: If the decision is confirmed in the Supreme Court's journal, o4 should gain this reading with its proof requirement. The record should then ask whether a return-to-home judgment exists and whether a bailiff's report of refusal was drawn up, and warn the lawyer, without blocking, that maintenance after the refusal is likely to be denied. Until then it is a lead to check in the court's journal.

attacks.claim: k30 says 'no special jurisdiction rule for a defendant abroad was found'. CPCA 41 and 42 are such rules: a foreigner, even one not resident in Algeria, may be summoned before Algerian courts on obligations he contracted with Algerians, in Algeria or abroad, and an Algerian may be summoned on obligations contracted abroad. For a wife who married a foreigner or an Algerian living abroad, these articles are what founds the Algerian court's international jurisdiction; CPCA 40 and 426 only allocate cases among Algerian courts.

source.what: Law 08-09 (CPCA), JO 21/2008, page 7, arts. 41 and 42 (French edition read on the page). The Arabic words are from the store text view, cpca 41 ¶1-2 and 42 ¶1.

attacks.quoteArabic: يجوز أن يكلف بالحضور كل أجنبي، حتى ولو لم يكن مقيما في الجزائر، أمام الجهات القضائية الجزائرية ... كما يجوز أيضا تكليفه بالحضور أمام الجهات القضائية الجزائرية بشأن التزامات تعاقد عليها في بلد أجنبي مع جزائريين. — يجوز أن يكلف بالحضور كل جزائري أمام الجهات القضائية الجزائرية بشأن التزامات تعاقد عليها في بلد أجنبي، حتى ولو كان مع أجنبي.
attacks.consequence: k30 and boundary n11 should cite CPCA 41-42 as the grounds of Algerian jurisdiction over a defendant abroad. Whether the duty of maintenance counts as an obligation 'contracted' is a reading to record as such. Service abroad (CPCA 414-415) stays as written.
